encoding: Each input is a finite binary64 value written in Python float.hex() form; conversion to Fraction.from_float is exact.

judgments.Sign: value is Positive, Negative, or Zero and must equal the exact sign.
judgments.Proven: value is '=' or '!=' and must match whether the exact expression is zero.
judgments.Refuse: A named conservative refusal; the judge checks the predicate and inputs but makes no completeness claim.

predicates.name: orient2d
predicates.meaning: Sign of the oriented area determinant.

predicates.name: orient3d
predicates.meaning: Sign convention used by wonky-num: positive when d is on the side of (b-a) cross (c-a).

predicates.name: incircle
predicates.meaning: Sign of the translated in-circle determinant; positive means inside for counterclockwise abc.

predicates.name: plane_side
predicates.meaning: Exact sign of the point relative to the plane through o with normal n.

predicates.name: one_surd_sign
predicates.meaning: Exact sign by sign cases and one squared-magnitude comparison.

predicates.name: two_surd_sign
predicates.meaning: Exact sign by first resolving a+b*sqrt(c), then a sign-aware squared-magnitude comparison.
